    if scoop is None or not arm_joint or not bucket_joint:

    phase_duration = 10.0
    phase = (t % phase_duration) / phase_duration
    
    # Phase-based control logic with improved dumping posture

        # Scooping phase: raise arm and open scoop
        arm_target = -math.radians(30)
        bucket_target = 0.0
